newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT plans 1,100 job cuts.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT plans 1,100 job cuts.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV said on Wednesday it planned to cut around 1,100 jobs from its PTT Telecom unit as part of a previously announced reorganisation of its telecom operations.
The jobs are to go from the Network Operations and Network Building arms of PTT Telecom with effect from October, a spokeswoman said.
PTT Telecom currently employs around 30,000 people, while the Dutch PTT group as a whole has around 90,000 employees.
